Apple to Enhance Mac Data Controls for AI Requests

Apple announced it will implement new measures to flag artificial intelligence requests for Mac data. This decision follows complaints regarding Meta's AI model, Muse, and aims to provide greater control over data access by AI agents on Mac devices.
